prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget, and whether you need creative/branding, digital performance, PR, B2B, etc.

Quick starting points:
- Barkley — KC-based, strong on creative, branding and integrated campaigns; good if you need big creative/brand work.
- VML (VMLY&R) — global full‑service and digital agency with KC roots; strong for integrated digital and large-scale enterprise work.
- Local boutiques and performance shops — smaller KC agencies often excel at paid media, SEO, social, and direct-response for tight budgets and fast results.

How I can help:
Tell me:
- What services you need (branding, web, SEO/ads, social, PR, B2B demand gen)
- Your budget range
- Your industry and target market
- Timeline and whether you need local vs. national reach

I’ll then give a tailored 3–5 agency shortlist with reasons, recent case examples, and questions to ask them. If you prefer, I can also point you to vetted directories (Clutch, Ad Age, KC Business Journal) and a short RFP template. Which would you like?
